library(shiny) library(bslib) library(plotly) library(leaflet) # Set up week labels for the app toggle week_labels <- paste0( "Week ", 1:53, " (", c("Early Jan","Early Jan", "Mid Jan", "Late Jan", "Late Jan", "Early Feb","Early Feb", "Late Feb","Late Feb", "Early Mar", "Early Mar","Mid Mar","Late Mar","Late Mar", "Early Apr", "Early Apr","Late Apr","Late Apr", "Early May","Early May", "Late May","Late May", "Early Jun", "Early Jun","Mid Jun","Late Jun","Late Jun", "Early Jul", "Early Jul","Late Jul", "Late Jul", "Early Aug", "Early Aug","Mid Aug","Late Aug","Late Aug", "Early Sep", "Early Sep","Late Sep","Late Sep", "Early Oct", "Early Oct","Late Oct","Late Oct", "Early Nov", "Early Nov","Mid Nov","Late Nov", "Late Nov", "Early Dec","Early Dec","Late Dec","Late Dec")[1:53], ")" ) # Use system fonts instead of Google Fonts my_theme <- bs_theme( base_font = font_collection("-apple-system", "BlinkMacSystemFont", "Segoe UI", "Roboto", "sans-serif") ) # Pull in data: df.wide <- readRDS("data/df_wide_preprocessed.rds") # spam.stat.areas <- readRDS("data/spam_stat_areas.rds") spam.stat.areas <- readRDS("data/spam_stat_areas_filtered.rds") # USER INTERFACE (UI) ------------------------------------------------------ ui <- page_navbar( title = "SPAM: Spawning Seasonality & Maturity Tracker", window_title = "SPAM Tracker", theme = bs_theme( version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly", base_font = font_collection("-apple-system", "BlinkMacSystemFont", "Segoe UI", "Roboto", "Helvetica Neue", "Arial", "sans-serif"), heading_font = font_collection("-apple-system", "BlinkMacSystemFont", "Segoe UI", "Roboto", "Helvetica Neue", "Arial", "sans-serif") ), tags$head( tags$style(HTML(" /* Keep map interactive borders sharp */ .leaflet-pane path.leaflet-interactive { stroke: #111111 !important; stroke-width: 1px !important; stroke-opacity: 0.9 !important; } /* Outline the Leaflet Minichart legend box in black */ .leaflet-control.minicharts-legend { border: 2px solid #000000 !important; border-radius: 6px !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2) !important; background-color: #FFFFFF !important; padding: 8px !important; } /* Clean popup theme rules */ .leaflet-popup-content-wrapper { font-family: 'Open Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif !important; border-radius: 8px !important; } .leaflet-popup-content { font-size: 15px !important; line-height: 1.5 !important; color: #2C3E50 !important; } .popup-title { font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; border-bottom: 2px solid #ECF0F1; padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 6px; } /* 🎨 NEW: Dark Slate Blue Theme for Card Headers */ .card-header { background-color: #2C3E50 !important; color: #FFFFFF !important; font-weight: bold !important; font-size: 15px !important; } /* 📱 NEW: Massive, easy-to-tap touch targets for filters */ .form-group label { font-weight: 700 !important; font-size: 16px !important; color: #2C3E50; margin-bottom: 6px; } .selectize-input { font-size: 18px !important; /* Large readable font size */ padding: 12px 16px !important; /* Extra thick padding for thick fingers */ line-height: 1.5 !important; border: 2px solid #BDC3C7 !important; /* Prominent border outline */ border-radius: 6px !important; } .selectize-dropdown { font-size: 18px !important; z-index: 9999 !important; /* Floats menu above all other cards */ max-height: 250px !important; /* Keeps list scrollable on smaller screens */ } .selectize-dropdown .option { padding: 10px 16px !important; /* Spacious items in the list */ } /* MOBILE NO-SCROLL MAGIC: Adjust heights automatically based on screen layout */ @media (min-width: 768px) { /* Desktop: Standard column sizing */ .desktop-card-height { height: 40vh !important; } .desktop-map-height { height: 80vh !important; } } @media (max-width: 767px) { /* Mobile: Lock visual height to prevent scrolling outside the viewing frame */ .mobile-stack-container { height: calc(100vh - 70px) !important; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; } .mobile-filter-card { flex: 0 0 auto; } .mobile-chart-card { flex: 1 1 30%; } .mobile-map-card { flex: 1 1 50%; } /* Force plot contents to scale instead of clipping out */ .shiny-plot-output, .leaflet-container { height: 100% !important; width: 100% !important; } } ")) ), nav_panel( title = "Weekly Tracker", div( class = "mobile-stack-container", layout_columns( col_widths = c(4, 8), # LEFT COLUMN (Controls & Chart stacked cleanly inside a standard div) div( class = "d-flex flex-column gap-3", card( class = "mobile-filter-card", card_header("Filter Panel"), selectizeInput( inputId = "selected_week", label = "Select Week of Year:", choices = setNames(1:53, week_labels), selected = 10, options = list( dropdownParent = "body" ) ) ), card( class = "desktop-card-height mobile-chart-card", card_header(uiOutput(outputId = "dynamic_regional_title")), plotlyOutput(outputId = "regional_pies", height = "100%"), full_screen = TRUE ) ), # RIGHT COLUMN (The Map Window) card( class = "mobile-map-card desktop-map-height", card_header("Mackerel Maturity Stages (Weekly Snapshot)"), leafletOutput(outputId = "maturity_map", height = "100%"), full_screen = TRUE ) ) ) ) ) # SERVER LOGIC ------------------------------------------------------------- server <- function(input, output, session) { # Calendar contextual banner rendering output$week_context_text <- renderUI({ wk <- as.numeric(input$selected_week) }) # Reactive map subset my_map_data <- reactive({ req(input$selected_week) selected_wk <- as.integer(input$selected_week) df.wide |> dplyr::filter(week == selected_wk & MAT != 0 & #as.numeric(input$selected_week) !is.na(stat.lat) & !is.na(stat.lon)) |> dplyr::group_by(area_code, region, stat.lat, stat.lon) |> dplyr::summarise( Immature = sum(MAT == 1, na.rm = TRUE), Developing = sum(MAT == 2, na.rm = TRUE), Spawning = sum(MAT %in% c(3,4), na.rm = TRUE), Spent = sum(MAT == 5, na.rm = TRUE), Resting = sum(MAT == 6, na.rm = TRUE), Max_Weight = max(OW, na.rm = TRUE), # Added na.rm = TRUE to prevent errors Avg_Weight = mean(OW, na.rm = TRUE), Min_Weight = min(OW, na.rm = TRUE), Max_Length = max(TL, na.rm = TRUE), Avg_Length = mean(TL, na.rm = TRUE), Min_Length = min(TL, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop" ) |> dplyr::mutate(Total_Samples = Immature + Developing + Spawning + Spent + Resting) }) # Reactive monthly spawn subset # month_data <- reactive({ # req(input$selected_week) # target_month <- df.wide |> # dplyr::filter(week == selected_week) |> #as.numeric(input$selected_week) # dplyr::pull(month) |> # unique() |> # na.omit() # if(length(target_month) > 1) target_month <- target_month[1] # # df.wide |> # tidyr::drop_na(MAT) |> # dplyr::filter(month == target_month & MAT !=0 & !is.na(region)) |> # dplyr::mutate(MAT = as.factor(MAT)) |> # dplyr::group_by(region,month)|> # dplyr::summarise( # Immature = sum(MAT == 1, na.rm = TRUE), # Developing = sum(MAT == 2, na.rm = TRUE), # Spawning = sum(MAT %in% c(3,4), na.rm = TRUE), # Spent = sum(MAT == 5, na.rm = TRUE), # Resting = sum(MAT == 6, na.rm = TRUE), # .groups = "drop" # ) |> # dplyr::mutate(Total_Samples = Immature + Developing + Spawning + Spent + Resting, # calc_month = month) # }) month_data <- reactive({ req(input$selected_week) selected_wk <- as.numeric(input$selected_week) # Safe extraction of month string sub_df <- df.wide[df.wide$week == selected_wk & !is.na(df.wide$month), ] if (nrow(sub_df) == 0) return(NULL) target_month <- as.character(sub_df$month[1]) res <- df.wide |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(MAT) & MAT != 0 & month == target_month & !is.na(region)) |> dplyr::mutate(MAT = as.character(MAT)) |> dplyr::group_by(region) |> dplyr::summarise( Immature = sum(MAT == "1", na.rm = TRUE), Developing = sum(MAT == "2", na.rm = TRUE), Spawning = sum(MAT %in% c("3","4"), na.rm = TRUE), Spent = sum(MAT == "5", na.rm = TRUE), Resting = sum(MAT == "6", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop" ) |> dplyr::mutate( Total_Samples = Immature + Developing + Spawning + Spent + Resting, calc_month = target_month ) if (nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL) res }) # Render base bathymetric ocean layout output$maturity_map <- renderLeaflet({ leaflet( options = leafletOptions( zoomControl = FALSE, minZoom = 6.3, maxZoom = 8, dragging = FALSE, doubleClickZoom = FALSE, scrollWheelZoom = FALSE, touchZoom = FALSE ) ) |> addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.OceanBasemap) |> addPolygons( data = spam.stat.areas, fillColor = "transparent", color = "#333333", weight = 1.5, opacity = 0.7, label = ~paste("Statistical Area:", Id), highlightOptions = highlightOptions( weight = 3, color = "#16a085", bringToFront = FALSE ) ) |> setView(lng = -70.0, lat = 41.5, zoom = 6) }) # Reactive map layer for updating pie charts # observe({ # data <- my_map_data() # # if (nrow(data) > 0) { # stages <- c('Immature', 'Developing', 'Spawning', 'Spent', 'Resting') # stage_colors <- c("#cccccc", "#56B4E9", "#FFC72C", "#2ecc71", '#CC79A7') # calculated_widths <- 18 + (data$Total_Samples * 0.15) # # popup_html_strings <- sprintf( # "
# Stat Area: %s
# Total Fish Sampled: %s
# Min & Max Weight: %s to %s g
# Min & Max Length: %s to %s cm
# Avg Weight: %s g
# Avg Length: %s cm #
", # data$area_code, # data$Total_Samples, # data$Min_Weight, # data$Max_Weight, # data$Min_Length/10, # data$Max_Length/10, # round(data$Avg_Weight, 1), # round(data$Avg_Length/10, 1) # ) # # # Extract matrix explicitly for leaflet.minicharts compatibility # chart_matrix <- as.matrix(data[, stages]) # mode(chart_matrix) <- "numeric" # # # Completely redraw the charts safely across weeks # leafletProxy("maturity_map", data = data) |> # clearMinicharts() |> # addMinicharts( # lng = data$stat.lon, # lat = data$stat.lat, # type = "pie", # chartdata = chart_matrix, #data[, stages], # colorPalette = stage_colors, # layerId = as.character(data$area_code), # width = calculated_widths, # popup = popupArgs(html = popup_html_strings), # transitionTime = 0, # legendPosition = "topleft" # ) # } else { # leafletProxy("maturity_map") |> # clearMinicharts() # } # }) # observeEvent(my_map_data(), { # data <- my_map_data() # # # 1. Always clear previous minicharts # leafletProxy("maturity_map") |> clearMinicharts() # # if (!is.null(data) && nrow(data) > 0) { # stages <- c('Immature', 'Developing', 'Spawning', 'Spent', 'Resting') # stage_colors <- c("#cccccc", "#56B4E9", "#FFC72C", "#2ecc71", '#CC79A7') # # # 2. Extract coordinates as clean, unclassed numeric vectors # lons <- as.numeric(as.character(data$stat.lon)) # lats <- as.numeric(as.character(data$stat.lat)) # widths <- as.numeric(18 + (data$Total_Samples * 0.15)) # # # 3. Create a clean matrix stripped of data.frame classes # mat <- as.matrix(data[, stages]) # chart_mat <- matrix( # as.numeric(mat), # nrow = nrow(mat), # ncol = ncol(mat), # dimnames = list(NULL, stages) # Preserve stage column names for legend # ) # # # 4. Strip linebreaks and special quotes from HTML popups # popups <- paste0( # "
", # "Stat Area: ", data$area_code, "
", # "Total Fish Sampled: ", data$Total_Samples, "
", # "Min & Max Weight: ", data$Min_Weight, " to ", data$Max_Weight, " g
", # "Min & Max Length: ", data$Min_Length/10, " to ", data$Max_Length/10, " cm
", # "Avg Weight: ", round(data$Avg_Weight, 1), " g
", # "Avg Length: ", round(data$Avg_Length/10, 1), " cm", # "
" # ) # # # 5. Render minicharts using explicit numeric variables # leafletProxy("maturity_map") |> # addMinicharts( # lng = lons, # lat = lats, # type = "pie", # chartdata = chart_mat, # colorPalette = stage_colors, # layerId = as.character(data$area_code), # width = widths, # popup = popupArgs(html = popups), # transitionTime = 0, # legendPosition = "topleft" # ) # } # }) # Reactive map layer for updating pie charts (Timing-safe for Shinylive) observeEvent(list(my_map_data(), input$maturity_map_bounds), { # Wait until both data and map bounds are initialized in JS req(input$maturity_map_bounds) data <- my_map_data() # 1. Always clear previous minicharts leafletProxy("maturity_map") |> leaflet.minicharts::clearMinicharts() if (!is.null(data) && nrow(data) > 0) { stages <- c('Immature', 'Developing', 'Spawning', 'Spent', 'Resting') stage_colors <- c("#cccccc", "#56B4E9", "#FFC72C", "#2ecc71", '#CC79A7') # 2. Extract coordinates as clean numeric vectors lons <- as.numeric(data$stat.lon) lats <- as.numeric(data$stat.lat) widths <- as.numeric(18 + (data$Total_Samples * 0.15)) # 3. Create a clean matrix mat <- as.matrix(data[, stages]) chart_mat <- matrix( as.numeric(mat), nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat), dimnames = list(NULL, stages) ) # 4. Clean HTML popup strings popups <- paste0( "
", "Stat Area: ", data$area_code, "
", "Total Fish Sampled: ", data$Total_Samples, "
", "Min & Max Weight: ", data$Min_Weight, " to ", data$Max_Weight, " g
", "Min & Max Length: ", data$Min_Length/10, " to ", data$Max_Length/10, " cm
", "Avg Weight: ", round(data$Avg_Weight, 1), " g
", "Avg Length: ", round(data$Avg_Length/10, 1), " cm", "
" ) # 5. Render minicharts safely leafletProxy("maturity_map") |> leaflet.minicharts::addMinicharts( lng = lons, lat = lats, type = "pie", chartdata = chart_mat, colorPalette = stage_colors, layerId = as.character(data$area_code), width = widths, popup = leaflet.minicharts::popupArgs(html = popups), transitionTime = 0, legendPosition = "topleft" ) } }, ignoreInit = FALSE) # Dynamic UI heading for the regional monthly pie charts # output$dynamic_regional_title <- renderUI({ # req(month_data()) # Pause rendering until the dataset calculates # current_month <- unique(month_data()$calc_month) # h4( # paste("Month at a Glance (By Region) —", current_month), # #style = "font-weight: bold; color: #2c3e50;" # ) # }) output$dynamic_regional_title <- renderUI({ m_data <- month_data() if (is.null(m_data) || nrow(m_data) == 0) { return("Month at a Glance") } current_month <- m_data$calc_month[1] paste("Month at a Glance (By Region) —", current_month) }) # Reactive map layer updating regional pie charts output$regional_pies <- renderPlotly({ req(month_data()) # Ensure data is loaded # Set color pallete to match map pies stage_colors <- c("#cccccc", "#56B4E9", "#FFC72C", "#2ecc71", '#CC79A7') # Transform your wide reactive data into long format for plotting long_data <- month_data() |> tidyr::pivot_longer( cols = c(Immature, Developing, Spawning, Spent, Resting), names_to = "Stage", values_to = "Count" ) # 2. Filter for North Region p_north <- plot_ly( data = dplyr::filter(long_data, region == "North"), labels = ~Stage, values = ~Count, marker = list(line = list(color = 'black', width = 1.5),colors = stage_colors), type = 'pie', name = "North", domain = list(x = c(0, 0.45)) ) # 3. Filter for South Region p_south <- plot_ly( data = dplyr::filter(long_data, region == "South"), labels = ~Stage, values = ~Count, marker = list(line = list(color = 'black', width = 1.5),colors = stage_colors), type = 'pie', name = "South", domain = list(x = c(0.55, 1)) ) # 4. Combine into one layout subplot(p_north, p_south, nrows = 1) |> layout( showlegend = FALSE, # margin = list(t = 40), # Adds a small space below UI text header annotations = list( list( text = "North", showarrow = FALSE, x = 0.07, y = 1.05, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", font = list(size = 16, face = "bold") ), list( text = "South", showarrow = FALSE, x = 0.78, y = 1.05, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", font = list(size = 16, face = "bold") ) ) ) }) } # RUN APPLICATION ---------------------------------------------------------- shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
